text: To be eligible, applicants must:(1) be a citizen of “Belt and Road” countries, be in good health mentally and physically, abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as campus rules and regulations, and respect Chinese customs.(2) be a bachelor’s degree holder and under the age of 35 when applying for master’s degree programs;(3) have relatively strong academic background in the field they intend to apply.(4) having a high level of English proficiency，such as having a bachelor’s degree taught in English, or TOEFL (iBT) score of 90 points at least, or IELTS score at least 6.0，
